cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: More Power, More Problems
cards.instruction: Celebrate every burden, restriction, or crisis as evidence that your influence is expanding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Another complaint about me! My influence now reaches the whole hotel. File it under my name, please, not 'general reception.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm taking you off reception while I investigate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Management attention as well. Record the investigation separately; we shouldn't confuse two levels of interest.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You'll answer every complaint in writing from the laundry office.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A correspondence operation in another department! Route all the letters there, please, in date order. I want this expanded reach properly organised.
